meta_description: PalawanPay Trilogy Marathon 2026 Cebu Leg review: September 27 in Mandaue City -- a fintech-sponsored RunRio race with a 3am gun start.
dek: Set for 27 September 2026 in Mandaue City with a 3:00am gun start, this Cebu leg of the PalawanPay Trilogy Marathon brings fintech-brand sponsorship to metro Cebu's industrial 'Little Rich City.'
verdict: The PalawanPay Trilogy Marathon's Cebu leg is sponsored by PalawanPay, a Philippine digital wallet/fintech brand -- a distinct sponsorship angle from the sportswear and beverage brands dominating most of this research batch. Four distances (5K to 21.1K, with an unusual 16K option) start at 3:00am in Mandaue City, one of Metro Cebu's two highly urbanized cities, sitting directly across the strait from Mactan-Cebu International Airport. Registration is already open, and RunRio's organisational experience across numerous other races in this research batch is a reasonable proxy for what to expect logistically.

sections.heading: A Fintech-Sponsored Race
paragraphs: The Cebu leg of the PalawanPay Trilogy Marathon is organised by RUNRIO Inc. with title sponsor PalawanPay, offering 21.1K, 16K, 10K and 5K distances, with a 3:00am gun start in Mandaue City. [1] PalawanPay is a Philippine digital wallet and remittance brand, giving this race a distinct fintech sponsorship angle compared to the sportswear- and beverage-branded events elsewhere in this research batch.

sections.heading: Mandaue: Metro Cebu's Industrial Core
paragraphs: Mandaue City is one of two highly urbanized cities in Cebu province (alongside the provincial capital, Cebu City), forming the core of Metropolitan Cebu together. [2] Nicknamed the 'Little Rich City,' it hosts roughly 10,000 industrial and commercial properties and lies directly across the strait from Mactan Island, connected via the Mactan-Cebu Bridge and Marcelo Fernan Bridge -- the only two routes to Mactan-Cebu International Airport, the country's second-busiest. That proximity makes the venue genuinely convenient for air travellers.

sections.heading: An Unusual 16K Distance
paragraphs: Alongside the standard 5K, 10K and 21.1K categories, this leg includes a 16K option -- an uncommon distance among the races covered in this research batch, most of which stick to round 5K increments. [1] That's likely tied to the broader PalawanPay Trilogy format, similar to how the Sante Barley Trilogy series builds toward specific qualifying distances across its legs.

sections.heading: Early Start, RunRio Standard Mechanics
paragraphs: The 3:00am gun start is earlier than most races in this research batch, likely reflecting standard heat-management practice for a large-field Metro Cebu event. sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If a fintech-sponsored race with strong airport proximity and RunRio's broad organisational experience appeals, the PalawanPay Trilogy Marathon's Cebu leg on 27 September 2026 is a reasonable pick, especially convenient for air travellers given Mandaue's direct bridge access to Mactan-Cebu International Airport. Registration is already open.
